updates.title: CVE-2026-69851: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. Admins should apply available security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in their identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69836: Microsoft Entra ID Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID allows an unauthorized attacker to execute arbitrary code over a network. This critical flaw requires immediate patching to prevent complete compromise of identity and access management systems.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Safeguards for Microsoft 365 Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now prevents sensitive data from being used in external web searches within Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, providing real-time protection against data leakage risks. This capability helps organizations maintain compliance by controlling sensitive data exposure when users leverage AI-powered search features.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: A new File Quarantine action in DLP policies for SharePoint and OneDrive automatically moves files to a restricted, admin-controlled location when policies are triggered, immediately removing user access while preserving files for review. This enforcement capability provides stronger, faster containment of sensitive data exposure incidents.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging for the Purview portal now provides clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes. This improvement strengthens accountability and compliance tracking for Purview administration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Customer-Managed Keys for Direct Export
updates.summary: eDiscovery now supports customer-managed key (CMK) encryption for direct export workflows, allowing organizations to control their own encryption keys in addition to Microsoft-managed encryption. This capability enhances data sovereignty and compliance requirements for sensitive investigations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Support for SharePoint Embedded Containers
updates.summary: eDiscovery users can now select and search user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers (used by Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks) as data sources for investigations. This expands eDiscovery coverage to modern collaborative workspaces where sensitive business content resides.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Security Triage Agent Reasoning Trace and Confidence Score
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in DLP now provides explainable decision-making through reasoning traces and confidence scores alongside alert recommendations. This transparency allows analysts to evaluate the reliability of automated agent decisions and reduces unnecessary manual review overhead.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Alert Integration with Microsoft Defender XDR
updates.summary: DLP alerts with Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations are now available in Microsoft Defender XDR, consolidating security alert visibility. This integration allows SOC teams to investigate data loss incidents alongside other security threats from a unified platform.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips for Outlook on Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips are now available in Microsoft Outlook for Mac, providing real-time notifications when emails contain sensitive data that violates policies. Users can remove non-compliant recipients or request policy overrides directly from the mail tip UI.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Retention Policies Based on Last Accessed Date
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now supports retention policies based on when files were last accessed in SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling organizations to automatically manage inactive data. This feature helps reduce storage costs and improves data governance by targeting stale content for disposal.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Hard Delete Capability for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: A new hard delete capability in Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to permanently remove content from OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows, enabling faster compliance enforcement. The feature includes safeguards to prevent inadvertent data loss from misconfigured policies.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Microsoft SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. Organizations running on-premises or hybrid SharePoint should prioritize patching to prevent privilege escalation attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Microsoft SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to tamper with content or settings over a network. Admins should apply security updates to prevent unauthorized modification of SharePoint data and configurations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Before enforcing an auto-labeling policy, admins can now run it in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled without making changes. The new Insights tab provides performance metrics and policy distribution data to help validate policy readiness before full enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access for Text Protection
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforcing DLP policies across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This network-level protection prevents sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud applications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing analysts to view and manage both classic and agent-triaged alerts in one location with integrated summaries and user details. This unified view reduces context-switching and improves alert response efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Expanded User Profile Details
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now displays additional user profile signals from Microsoft Entra including office location, employee type, department, and last working date in alert details. These enriched signals help analysts better contextualize user behavior and assess insider risk more accurately.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Enhanced Note Capabilities
updates.summary: Analysts can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases in Insider Risk Management, with automatic system-generated notes for status changes, reassignments, and escalations. This improves audit trail documentation and collaboration among investigation teams.
